solver = z3.Solver()

# Blocked intervals for each participant in minutes since 9:00 AM
blocked_intervals = [
    # Diane

    (360, 450),   # 15:00-16:30
]

# Add constraints to avoid overlaps with blocked intervals

    solver.add(z3.Or(E <= b_start, S >= b_end))
